name: Business Economics
description: Long-form economics explainers about what it costs, earns, and risks to own or operate a real business.
audience: Curious viewers, aspiring owners, operators, founders, and business students.
tagline: What it really costs to own the business.
perspective_policy: Third-person operator documentary; never provide individual investment, tax, legal, or regulatory advice.

narrative_quality_contract.opening_policy: Open with a concrete ownership scenario and financial tension.
required_habits: State geography, currency, scale, and time period for material figures.
Separate sourced facts from representative assumptions.
Explain the operating equation behind every major number.
narrative_quality_contract.closing_policy: End with a balanced ownership verdict and hidden trade-off.

metadata_profile.label: Evidence-led YouTube package
metadata_profile.description: Direct summary, sources when research exists, CTA, disclosure, and focused hashtags.

narrative_rules: Profile one specific business or operation.
Keep revenue, gross profit, operating profit, owner compensation, cash flow, and return on capital distinct.
title_rules: Avoid unsupported earnings claims, fake precision, and hype.

pacing_arc: Revenue engine, fixed and variable costs, people, break-even, failure, and ownership verdict.
additional_rules: Include a counterintuitive cost, bottleneck, failure mode, and scaling constraint.

example_topics: The Economics of Owning a Coffee Shop
The Economics of Running an Airline
audience_hint: Curious viewers, aspiring owners, operators, founders, and business students who want financially honest explanations.
idea_system_prompt_role: Generate one concrete operating-model case study about a recognizable business, company type, venue, or commercial operation.
idea_guidance_text: Vary local service, retail, hospitality, professional practice, industrial operation, digital company, franchise, property-heavy venue, and high-capital operation.
script_context: Treat each episode as an operating-model case study, not entrepreneurship motivation or personal financial advice.
script_system_prompt_role: Write like an experienced operator and economics journalist revealing the hidden machine behind a familiar business.
script_closing_hint: State what the business can reward, what it demands, and the decisive trade-off.

narrator_styles.label: Curious economics
narrator_styles.description: Accessible inquiry into familiar commercial mechanisms.

title_shape_rules: The Economics of Running {Specific Business or Company}
So You Want to Own {Specific Business}
metadata_title_hook_rules: Name exactly one business or operation.
metadata_tags_hook_rules: Use only operating terms actually covered.
